capabilities: Chat with Pi or Antigravity agent sessions in a side pane
Run vault-aware agent tools (read, write, edit, grep, find, bash)
Send highlighted text and review color-coded inline diffs before applying edits
Fork conversations from any earlier message to explore alternatives
Attach notes, folders, PDFs, and images via @ fuzzy search
extras: Installs via BRAT or manual release. Agent processes run locally and can execute shell commands in the workspace when instructed. Dual-language UI (English and Simplified Chinese); part of the README is in Chinese. GPL-3.0 license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in autonomous agent that can run shell tools, search the vault, and apply reviewed edits to notes.

relations.evidence: powered by Pi Coding Agent and Google Antigravity CLI
Antigravity CLI (agy): Google's autonomous agent CLI

requires.name: Pi CLI or Antigravity CLI installed locally
Provider API keys for Pi models

summary: AI agent panel that embeds local Pi Coding Agent or Google Antigravity CLI into Obsidian to read, search, and edit vault notes.
